load_camembert_pretrained: load a pretrained CamemBERT French language model using CamembertModel.from_pretrained with a model name or path
list_camembert_hub_models: list available CamemBERT hub model variants and their download URLs using CamembertModel.hub_models
encode_french_text: encode a French sentence into BPE token IDs using the RobertaHubInterface encode method
extract_camembert_features: extract feature representations from tokenized French text using the RobertaHubInterface extract_features method
fill_camembert_mask: fill masked tokens in French text with top-k predictions using the RobertaHubInterface fill_mask method
